copy.returns: the end time in AudioContext seconds
copy.chains: one master chain per destination, kept on the context in ac.timbreChains

levels.about: Measured by gates/check_levels.mjs in dBFS after the master chain on a warm chain. peak and rms: at the defaults (the worst peak and the mean RMS of 3 seeds). worstPeak, worstRms and lowestPeak: over all 12 renders (the defaults and 3 random parameter sets, 3 seeds each). pre: the highest peak before the limiter over all renders. end: where the default render falls below -60 dBFS, in seconds.

families.soft: Muted, rounded and padded: sine blips, thocks, gentle swells and quiet chimes
families.glass: Bright, clear and ringing: glassy ticks, pings, crystal and glints
families.wood: Knocks, clacks and taps of wood, clay or bone: blocks, clocks, board pieces, chips, dice
families.metal: Struck and ringing metal: coins, keys, blades, hammers
families.mechanical: Switches, keys, latches, machines and hum
families.air: Whooshes, breaths, swishes, slides and wind
families.chip: 8-bit square and pulse voices: chiptune, arcade and retro computer beeps
families.synthetic: Electronic tones: buzzes, lasers, FM, sweeps, pads, drones and sci-fi machines
families.organic: Natural sources: water, fire, weather, birds, bubbles, footsteps, a bowstring
families.orchestral: Tuned instruments in a phrase: bells, plucks, mallets, harp and brass
families.impact: Blows, thuds and booms: punches, heavy hits, landings and explosions

roles.on: Switch: 1 plays the on direction (check, enable, switch on), 0 the off direction
roles.open: Switch: 1 plays opening (expand, show, slide in), 0 closing
roles.chip: Switch: 1 swaps in an 8-bit square-wave voicing, 0 keeps the softer voice
roles.go: Switch: 1 plays the longer, higher go cue that ends a countdown, 0 a count beat

moments.click: A button, link or control is pressed.
moments.hover: The pointer moves over or focuses a control.
moments.toggle-on: A switch, checkbox or setting is turned on.
moments.toggle-off: A switch, checkbox or setting is turned off.
moments.type: A key is pressed while typing.
moments.open: A menu, panel, modal or drawer opens or slides in.
moments.close: A menu, panel, modal or drawer closes.
moments.transition: A screen, page or scene changes; something sweeps past.
moments.scroll: A scroll wheel, picker or slider passes a notch.
moments.drag: An item is picked up to be dragged.
moments.drop: A dragged item lands on its target.
moments.tooltip: A tooltip, hint or popover appears.
moments.copy: Something is copied to the clipboard.
moments.undo: An action is undone or reverted.
moments.delete: Something is removed, trashed or cleared.
moments.send: A message or form is sent, submitted or published.
moments.success: An action finished well: saved, sent, paid, completed.
moments.error: An action was rejected or failed: invalid input, denied, failed.
moments.warning: Something needs attention but did not fail.
moments.info: Neutral news: nothing wrong, nothing won.
moments.message: A message, chat or email arrives.
moments.reminder: A calendar event, reminder or due date comes up.
moments.timer: A timer, countdown or alarm ends.
moments.achievement: A milestone, badge or reward is earned.
moments.hit: A blow lands: a hit, impact or strike.
moments.pickup: An item is picked up or collected.
moments.coin: A coin, currency or small reward is gained or spun.
moments.level-up: The player levels up or unlocks something big.
moments.power-up: A power-up, boost or buff is collected.
moments.victory: The player wins a round or finishes a level.
moments.game-over: The player loses or the run ends.
moments.footstep: A footstep while walking or running.
moments.shoot: A weapon fires: a laser, blaster, arrow or shot.
moments.countdown: A countdown beat before a round starts.
moments.card-draw: A card is drawn, dealt or flicked.
moments.card-flip: A card is turned face up.
moments.shuffle: A deck is shuffled or riffled.
moments.sparkle: A magical twinkle: a bonus, a reveal.
moments.power-down: A machine, shield or system powers down.
moments.door: A door, hatch or chest opens or latches.
moments.shield: A shield or force field goes up or takes a hit.
moments.readout: A console or HUD prints a readout or acknowledges.
moments.scan: A scanner, radar or sensor sweeps.
moments.chips: Poker chips are clicked, stacked or pushed.
moments.scare: A sting for a scare, a twist or a mystery.
moments.ambience: A bed of sound under a scene.
moments.music: A short musical phrase, sting or jingle.

sounds.name: Checkbox
sounds.desc: A bright two-note pluck when a box is checked and a short muted drop when it is cleared.

on.desc: 1 plays the rising two-note check, 0 the single muted falling uncheck

pitch.desc: Base note: the check rises a fifth above it, the uncheck falls from that fifth

bright.desc: Check sparkle: 0 pure notes, 1 octave overtones and a crisper tick; uncheck ignores it

sounds.name: Crisp Click
sounds.desc: A dry, snappy click for primary buttons: a bandpassed noise transient over a stiff triangle tick, gone in 30 ms.

pitch.desc: Tuning of the click: sets the noise snap band and the triangle tick under it

snap.desc: Loudness of the noise transient: 0 a subdued tick, 1 a sharp crack

body.desc: Level of the low triangle tick under the snap: 0 thin, 1 fuller

sounds.name: Deep Click
sounds.desc: A low, padded thock for heavy buttons and primary actions: a falling sine body with a soft knock on top.

pitch.desc: How low the thock sits; its octave overtone follows

click.desc: Level of the noise knock on top: 0 mostly a padded thump, 1 a pronounced knock

length.desc: Decay of the sine body and overtone: 0 a tight thud, 1 a longer falling thock

sounds.name: Glass Click
sounds.desc: A bright, glassy tick for buttons: a few high inharmonic partials with a short ring, light and clean.

pitch.desc: Base frequency of the glassy partials

ring.desc: Decay of the glass tone: 0 a short tick, 1 a longer ring

bright.desc: Top partial and air tick level: 0 rounder, 1 sparkly with more air

sounds.name: Soft Click
sounds.desc: A short muted tick for button presses: a falling sine blip with a breath of high noise.

pitch.desc: Start note of the falling sine blip

tone.desc: Brightness and level of the high noise breath: 0 muted, 1 crisp and airy

sounds.name: Wooden Click
sounds.desc: A warm wooden knock for buttons: a short damped block tone with a dull knuckle thud, calm enough to repeat all day.

pitch.desc: Note of the block tone, which droops slightly as it rings

ring.desc: Decay of the block tone: 0 a dead knock, 1 a short resonant ring

hollow.desc: Level of the inharmonic overtone: 0 solid and dull, 1 hollow like a woodblock

sounds.name: Copy to Clipboard
sounds.desc: A quick rising scoop and a bright ping to confirm a copy to the clipboard.

pitch.desc: Note of the confirming bell ping

scoop.desc: Loudness of the rising noise scoop that leads into the ping

ring.desc: Decay of the ping: 0 a short blip, 1 a longer ring

sounds.name: Delete to Trash
sounds.desc: A short paper crumple that drops into a bin with a dull thud, for deleting or discarding an item.

crunch.desc: How many paper crackles play before the thud; more makes a longer crumple

pitch.desc: Tuning of the landing thud

weight.desc: Loudness of the landing thud and its knock, light to heavy

sounds.name: Drag Drop
sounds.desc: A soft landing thud for dropping an item on its target, with an optional small bounce as it settles.

pitch.desc: Tuning of the landing thud and its bounce

bounce.desc: Level of the small second bounce: 0 none, 1 a clear settle

snap.desc: Level of the noise knock on impact: 0 soft and padded, 1 a sharper knock

sounds.name: Drag Pickup
sounds.desc: A soft lift for grabbing an item to drag: a small grip tick and a short rising breath.

pitch.desc: Start note of the rising triangle tone

lift.desc: How far the breath and tone rise: 0 a small lift, 1 a wide upward sweep

air.desc: Loudness of the rising breath of noise

sounds.name: Expand and Collapse
sounds.desc: A quick stepped run of soft blips: rising when a section expands, falling and a touch quieter when it collapses.

open.desc: 1 plays the rising expand run, 0 the falling, slightly quieter collapse run

steps.desc: Number of blips in the run

gap.desc: Time between blips: short for a quick flutter, long for a stepped run

pitch.desc: Lowest note of the run; the others climb the pentatonic above it

sounds.name: Focus Ring
sounds.desc: A soft pip with a few fading echoes for keyboard focus landing on a control, like a ring spreading outward.

pitch.desc: Note of the pip, which bends slightly upward

spread.desc: Time between echoes: short sounds tight, long spreads the ring outward

echo.desc: Level of the fading echoes against the dry pip: low mostly pip, high a clear ring

sounds.name: Hover Tick
sounds.desc: A barely-there high tick for the pointer entering a button or row. Very quiet, meant to repeat.

pitch.desc: Frequency of the tick, which dips slightly as it fades

air.desc: Level of the high noise hiss over the tone: 0 mostly pure, 1 breathier

sounds.name: Light Keypress
sounds.desc: A light, quiet keypress for typing: a soft thump and tap that varies a little each press; size reaches the spacebar.

pitch.desc: Tuning of the low thump, varied a little on each press

bright.desc: Tone of the tap on top: 0 dull and muted, 1 brighter and clickier

size.desc: Key size: 0 a letter key, 1 a spacebar with a lower, longer, louder thump

sounds.name: Mechanical Keypress
sounds.desc: A mechanical keyboard keypress: a bright click, a bottom-out thock and a faint release tick, different every time.

pitch.desc: Tuning of the bright click leaf, varied slightly per press

click.desc: Loudness of the click leaf and release tick: 0 a linear switch, 1 clicky

thock.desc: Loudness of the bottom-out thock: 0 light, 1 heavy

sounds.name: Menu Slide
sounds.desc: An airy slide for a menu or drawer opening (rising, soft landing) and closing (falling, latch tick); size runs from dropdown to drawer.

open.desc: 1 plays the rising open with a soft landing, 0 the falling close with a latch tick

size.desc: Slide length, dropdown to drawer; on open also a lower, heavier landing

tone.desc: Register of the air sweep: 0 darker and lower, 1 brighter and higher

sounds.name: Modal Open and Close
sounds.desc: A soft low swell for a dialog opening, with a small glint on arrival, and a quick falling sigh for it closing.

open.desc: 1 plays the rising swell with a glint, 0 the quick falling sigh

pitch.desc: Tuning of the low swell or sigh tones; the glint stays fixed

air.desc: Loudness of the breath of air in the swell or sigh

shine.desc: Level of the high bell glint: 0 faint, 1 clear; it droops on close

sounds.name: Page Turn
sounds.desc: A paper page turned: a soft sweep of air, light rustles and a quiet landing. For pagers, carousels and readers.

length.desc: Duration of the turn: sweep, rustles and landing all stretch with it

rustle.desc: Level of the scattered paper rustles: 0 none, 1 crisp

bright.desc: Register of the air sweep: 0 darker and lower, 1 brighter and higher

sounds.name: Radio Select
sounds.desc: A soft rounded bloop for picking one option from a group: a sine that bends upward over a quiet low body.

pitch.desc: Start note of the bloop; its octave-down body follows

bloop.desc: How far the sound bends upward: 0 a gentle lift, 1 a big rising bloop

round.desc: Level of the octave-down body: 0 thinner and chirpier, 1 fuller and rounder

sounds.name: Scroll Detent
sounds.desc: A tiny dry wooden tick for one notch of a scroll wheel or picker; raise ticks for a quick flick through several.

ticks.desc: How many notches tick past: 1 a single notch, more for a quick flick

pitch.desc: Note of each tick's short ring, varied slightly per notch

gap.desc: Time between notches when ticks is above 1: short spins fast, long slower

sounds.name: Slider Detent
sounds.desc: A small pitched tick for a slider thumb crossing a notch; set pos from the thumb position and a drag climbs a scale.

pitch.desc: Tick note at the bottom of the track; pos lifts it up to an octave

pos.desc: Thumb position along the track: 0 base note, 1 an octave up

edge.desc: Level of the noise click on top: 0 a soft tonal tick, 1 a sharp edge

sounds.name: Tap
sounds.desc: A soft fingertip tap for touch screens and list rows: a muffled pat over a short mid thud, rounder than a click.

pitch.desc: Tuning of the short mid thud

pat.desc: Loudness of the muffled noise pat over the thud

soft.desc: Muffling of the pat: 0 brighter and clearer, 1 duller and softer

sounds.name: Toggle Switch
sounds.desc: A two-stage click-clack for switches: rising when turned on, falling when turned off.

on.desc: 1 plays the click pair rising, 0 plays it falling

pitch.desc: Note of the higher click; the other sits about a fourth below

gap.desc: Time between the two clicks; the low thock lands with the second

body.desc: Level of the low thock under the second click: 0 none, 1 solid

sounds.name: Tooltip Pop
sounds.desc: A tiny glassy bubble pop for a tooltip or popover appearing: a bright pip that bends up and settles.

pitch.desc: Start note of the pip before it bends up

rise.desc: How far the pip bends up: 0 steady, 1 nearly an octave

shimmer.desc: Starting FM glitter before it settles: 0 nearly pure, 1 bright and sparkly

sounds.name: Undo
sounds.desc: A short rewind flutter that falls and settles with a soft tick, for undoing the last action.

pitch.desc: Start note of the falling flutter; the settle tick sits an octave below

speed.desc: Flutter rate of the rewind: low a slow wobble, high a fast whir

settle.desc: Level of the soft tick where it settles: 0 faint, 1 clear

sounds.name: Achievement Unlocked
sounds.desc: A quick rising run into a warm bell chord with a few glints. A small celebration for something earned.

pitch.desc: Root note: transposes the run, the bell chord and the glints together

gap.desc: Spacing of the three run notes; the bell chord lands after the third

space.desc: Reverb mix over the whole sound, from dry to roomy

sparkle.desc: Level of the high sine glints over the chord, 0 removes them

sounds.name: Gentle Alarm
sounds.desc: Soft rounded beeps in rising pairs that swell round by round. Wakes you without startling you.

pitch.desc: Note of the first beep in each pair; the second is a fifth higher

rounds.desc: How many rounds of rising beep pairs play

pace.desc: Time between the two beeps in a pair

swell.desc: How much quieter the early rounds are: 0 all equal, 1 a strong build

sounds.name: Calendar Event
sounds.desc: A tiny page-flip tick and two soft plucked notes rising a fourth. An event is starting; warm and organized, not urgent.

pitch.desc: Note of the first pluck; the second sits the interval above

interval.desc: How far the second pluck rises above the first

gap.desc: Time between the two plucks

bright.desc: Opening filter cutoff of each pluck: low soft and muted, high twangy

tick.desc: Level of the page-flip noise tick before the notes, 0 removes it

sounds.name: Attention Double Tap
sounds.desc: Two soft wooden knocks, each a touch lower and quieter. A gentle "excuse me" that is barely a sound.

pitch.desc: Body pitch of the first knock; each later knock is a bit lower

gap.desc: Time between knocks, with a slight natural wobble

wood.desc: Level of the woody click on each knock: 0 a pure thud, 1 crisp wood

taps.desc: Number of knocks, each lower and softer than the last

sounds.name: Download Complete
sounds.desc: A soft downward glide that settles with a gentle thump and a small ting. The file is in place.

pitch.desc: Landing note; the glide starts an octave above it, the ting a fifth up

fall.desc: Length of the downward glide, which also delays the landing

thump.desc: Level of the low thump on landing, 0 removes it

ring.desc: How long the landing note and the ting ring out

sounds.name: Error Buzz
sounds.desc: A low falling double buzz for a rejected action. Clear without being harsh.

pitch.desc: Note of the first buzz; each further pulse steps lower

rough.desc: Depth of the fast level trill: 0 a smooth tone, 1 a rattling buzz

tone.desc: Lowpass cutoff: low is dull and muffled, high is brighter and edgier

sounds.name: Incoming Call Ring
sounds.desc: A short bell-like phone ring: bursts of fast alternating notes with a pause between. Loops cleanly if you repeat it.

pitch.desc: Lower note of the trill; the upper note is a major third above

rate.desc: Speed of the note alternation: low a slow warble, high a fast trill

tone.desc: Lowpass cutoff: low is soft and muted, high rings brighter

sounds.name: Info Ping
sounds.desc: One soft bell tap for neutral news: nothing wrong and nothing won, just a heads-up. Made to be heard all day.

pitch.desc: Note of the bell tap

decay.desc: How long the bell rings out

bright.desc: Level of the octave and the glassy partial: 0 soft and pure, 1 brighter

sounds.name: Low Battery
sounds.desc: Three slow falling notes under a closing filter, the last one sagging. Power is running out.

pitch.desc: Note of the first step; each next step falls a whole tone

steps.desc: Number of falling notes; the last one always sags

gap.desc: Time between the falling notes

tone.desc: Starting lowpass cutoff, closing as the notes fall: low muffled, high clearer

sounds.name: Mention Ping
sounds.desc: A quick grace note into a glassy bell ting with a soft echo. Stands out from ordinary messages without shouting.

pitch.desc: Note of the bell ting; the grace note before it is a fifth below

glass.desc: Level of the inharmonic partial: 0 a round ting, 1 a glassy metallic edge

ring.desc: How long the bell ting rings out

echo.desc: Level of the soft echo trailing the ting, 0 dry

sounds.name: Message Received
sounds.desc: Two quick bubbly pops rising a fourth, like a chat bubble arriving. Friendly and short enough for a busy channel.

pitch.desc: Note of the first pop; the second sits the interval above

interval.desc: How far the second pop rises above the first

gap.desc: Time between the two pops

pop.desc: Depth of the upward slide into each note: 0 a plain sine, 1 a bubbly bloop

sounds.name: Message Sent
sounds.desc: A soft rising whoosh into a tiny blip: your message is on its way. Quiet enough to play on every send.

pitch.desc: Note of the closing blip

speed.desc: Length of the whoosh before the blip: low quick, high slower

air.desc: Loudness of the rising air whoosh, from faint to breathy

sounds.name: New Mail
sounds.desc: A soft falling swish into a short-long two-bell "tu-ding". A letter has landed in the inbox.

pitch.desc: Note of the short first bell; the long second bell is the interval above

interval.desc: How far the second bell rises above the first

swish.desc: Loudness of the falling air swish before the bells

ring.desc: How long the second, longer bell rings out

sounds.name: Reminder Chime
sounds.desc: A soft two-bell "ding-dong" with a little room around it. A polite nudge that something is due.

pitch.desc: Note of the first bell, the ding

drop.desc: How far the second bell, the dong, falls below the first

gap.desc: Time between the ding and the dong

ring.desc: How long each bell rings out

space.desc: Reverb mix around the bells, from dry to a small roomy wash

sounds.name: Success Chime
sounds.desc: A gentle two-note rising chime for a completed action. Not a fanfare; a quiet yes.

pitch.desc: Note of the first chime; the second sits the interval above

interval.desc: How far the second note rises above the first

gap.desc: Time between the two notes

shimmer.desc: Level of the octave sine over the second note: 0 plain, 1 bright

sounds.name: Sync Done
sounds.desc: A quick back-and-forth of two notes that settles on the octave. Everything is in step again.

pitch.desc: Root of the back-and-forth; it swaps with the fifth and lands an octave up

cycles.desc: Number of root-fifth back-and-forth pairs before the landing note

speed.desc: Time per quick note: low a fast flutter, high a slower swap

shimmer.desc: Level of the high sine on the landing note, 0 removes it

sounds.name: Task Failed
sounds.desc: A run of low falling buzzes that sags on the last one. Something you were waiting on did not work out; firm, not harsh.

pitch.desc: Note of the first buzz and the sine under it; later pulses step lower

pulses.desc: Number of falling buzz pulses; the last one sags

rough.desc: Depth of the fast level trill: 0 a smooth tone, 1 a rattling buzz

weight.desc: Level of the low falling sine under the first pulse, 0 removes it

sounds.name: Upload Complete
sounds.desc: A soft upward glide that lands on a bright chime note. The file has arrived.

pitch.desc: Base pitch: the glide rises from below it to a landing note a fifth up

rise.desc: Length of the upward glide, which also delays the landing note

ring.desc: How long the landing note and its shimmer ring out

shimmer.desc: Level of the octave sine over the landing note, 0 removes it

sounds.name: Warning Tone
sounds.desc: A two-note falling "uh-oh" in a round triangle tone. Cautions without scolding; milder than the error buzz.

pitch.desc: Note of the first, short note of the uh-oh

drop.desc: How far the second note falls below the first

gap.desc: Time between the two notes

tone.desc: Lowpass cutoff: low is round and muted, high is brighter

sounds.name: Arrow Shot
sounds.desc: A bowstring twang and the zip of an arrow leaving. For archers and ranged attacks.

pitch.desc: Note of the plucked bowstring and the short thump under it

flight.desc: How long the arrow's falling noise zip lasts as it recedes

twang.desc: String brightness and sustain: 0 a dull short pluck, 1 a bright ringing twang

sounds.name: Bounce
sounds.desc: A rubbery boing: a quick spring up, then a wobble that settles. For jump pads, springs and balls.

pitch.desc: Note the boing settles on after springing up to nearly an octave above

wobble.desc: Vibrato on the settle: 0 a clean glide, 1 a wide rubbery wobble

length.desc: How long the boing takes to settle back down and fade

sounds.name: Checkpoint
sounds.desc: A soft thump and three bells fanning up that ring together: progress saved. Warmer than a success chime.

pitch.desc: Root note of the three-bell chord of root, fifth and octave

spread.desc: Gap between the three bell strikes, from near-chord to a slow fan

ring.desc: How long each bell rings out

sounds.name: Coin Flip
sounds.desc: A coin spun into the air: rising ticks as it turns, then a bright ping when it lands.

spins.desc: How many rising ticks play while the coin turns before it lands

spin.desc: Time between spin ticks; longer also delays the landing ping

pitch.desc: Note of the landing ping; the spin ticks follow it, lower down

ring.desc: How long the landing ping rings out

sounds.name: Combo Ping
sounds.desc: A short bright ping that rises one scale step per streak count, so a combo plays a rising tune. Chip makes it a square ping.

pitch.desc: Base note at a streak of 1; higher streaks climb a pentatonic scale from it

streak.desc: Combo count: each step plays the next note up a pentatonic scale

ring.desc: How long the ping rings out

chip.desc: 1 a bitcrushed square ping, 0 a soft near-harmonic bell

sounds.name: Countdown Beep
sounds.desc: The beep for 3, 2, 1 in a race or round start; turn Go on for the longer, higher start tone.

pitch.desc: Note of the beep; Go plays an octave above it

length.desc: How long the beep holds; Go stretches it further

go.desc: 1 the start tone: octave up, longer, with a fifth, 0 a plain count beep

chip.desc: 1 a bitcrushed square beep, 0 a clean sine with a soft octave

sounds.name: Door Open
sounds.desc: A latch clicks and a wooden hinge creaks open. Use a short length for a quick door, long for a spooky one.

pitch.desc: Starting note of the hinge creak, which climbs as the door swings

length.desc: How long the hinge creaks as the door swings open

creak.desc: Roughness of the hinge: 0 a smoother groan, 1 a juddering, wobbly creak with grit

sounds.name: Double Jump
sounds.desc: Two hops in a row, the second higher and quicker, for a mid-air jump. Chip is square; off is soft triangle.

pitch.desc: Starting note of the first hop's sweep; the second hop scales with it

gap.desc: Time between the first hop and the second

lift.desc: How much higher the second hop starts than the first

chip.desc: 1 a bitcrushed square voice, 0 a soft triangle with a sine sheen and air puff

sounds.name: Explosion Soft
sounds.desc: A big but friendly boom: a round blast with a pop on the front and crackles after. Cartoon, not harsh.

size.desc: How long the boom's noise body and falling sub last

pitch.desc: Base note of the falling sub under the blast; lower is deeper

soften.desc: Darkens the blast: 0 a brighter bang, 1 a muffled puff

crackle.desc: Loudness of the tiny crackles scattered after the boom, 0 none

sounds.name: Footstep Hard
sounds.desc: A step on wood, tile or stone: a crisp tap with a knock under it. Use Vary for a walking rhythm.

surface.desc: Floor material: 0 wood with a dull, lower knock, 1 stone with a bright click and ring

weight.desc: How heavy the step is: a louder knock and a stronger low thud under it

pitch.desc: Scales the tuning of the whole step: click, knock, thud and ring

sounds.name: Footstep Soft
sounds.desc: A quiet step on carpet, grass or sand. Use Vary so a walk never repeats exactly.

weight.desc: How heavy the step is: a louder puff and a fuller low thud

surface.desc: Ground type: 0 muffled carpet, 1 brighter gravel with a little crunch

length.desc: How long each step's puff and thud last

sounds.name: Gem Collect
sounds.desc: A crystalline two-strike ring for a gem or treasure: bright, glassy and a little longer than a coin.

pitch.desc: Note of the first glass strike; the second rings a fifth above

ring.desc: How long the glass strikes ring, the second a bit longer

gap.desc: Time between the two glass strikes

sparkle.desc: Level of the airy shimmer on the second strike, 0 none

sounds.name: Hammer Hit
sounds.desc: A hammer swung and landing on metal: air, then a clank with a thump under it.

swing.desc: Length of the rising air before impact; near zero it hits at once

pitch.desc: Note of the metal clank and its falling ring

weight.desc: Low body thump at contact: 0 a thin clank, 1 a heavy hit

ring.desc: How long the metal clank rings out

sounds.name: Heal
sounds.desc: A warm rising swell with a soft glow on top, for health restored. Gentle by design; it can repeat.

pitch.desc: Starting root of the rising root, fifth and octave chord

length.desc: How long the swell lasts; its slow bloom and rise stretch with it

rise.desc: How far the chord glides up during the swell; 0 holds steady

glow.desc: Level of the airy glow and the bell at the crest: 0 a plain swell

sounds.name: Hit Heavy
sounds.desc: A heavy blow landing: deep sub, a body of rumble and a hard crack. For bosses, crits and slams.

weight.desc: Heft of the blow: a louder sub and rumble body

pitch.desc: Base note of the falling sub; lower is deeper

crack.desc: Level of the hard high crack at the moment of impact

tail.desc: How long the rumble body and sub carry on after the hit

sounds.name: Hit Light
sounds.desc: A quick, light strike landing: a short knock with a crisp crack. Small enough to chain in a fight.

pitch.desc: Note of the short falling knock

snap.desc: Crack brightness and level: 0 a dull tap, 1 a crisp bright snap

body.desc: Level of the knock under the crack: 0 thin, 1 fat

sounds.name: Hurt
sounds.desc: A falling, wobbling "ow" with a crunch on the hit, for the player taking damage. Chip is square; off is a softer saw.

pitch.desc: Starting note of the falling ow

drop.desc: How far the ow falls in pitch: low a slight sag, high a deep plunge

length.desc: How long the ow lasts; the falling glide stretches with it

chip.desc: 1 a bitcrushed square ow, 0 a softer sawtooth through a closing lowpass

sounds.name: Jump
sounds.desc: The classic platformer hop: a quick rising sweep. Chip is a stepped square wave; off is a soft triangle.

pitch.desc: Starting note of the upward sweep

rise.desc: How far the sweep climbs above the start note

length.desc: How long the hop lasts and how slowly it sweeps

chip.desc: 1 a stepped, bitcrushed square sweep, 0 a soft triangle with a sine octave

sounds.name: Key Unlock
sounds.desc: A key jingles, turns and the lock gives: tiny metal ticks, a bolt clunk and a small ding.

pitch.desc: Note of the metal jingles; the final ding sits an octave below

jingles.desc: How many tiny key jingles rattle before the turn

clunk.desc: Weight of the deadbolt: a louder low thud and knock

ding.desc: Level of the small reward ding after the bolt, 0 none

sounds.name: Land
sounds.desc: A character landing after a jump or fall: a soft thump with a scuff of grit. Heavier settings hit longer.

weight.desc: Heft of the landing: a louder, longer thump and impact puff

pitch.desc: Note of the falling thump; lower is deeper

scuff.desc: Grit on landing: a louder, longer scuff and a brighter puff

sounds.name: Pickup Item
sounds.desc: A soft two-note blip for picking up an item. Quiet enough to repeat. Chip switches to square notes.

pitch.desc: Note of the first blip

interval.desc: How far above the first blip the second one lands

gap.desc: Time between the two blips

chip.desc: 1 two bitcrushed square notes, 0 soft sines with a sparkle and a speck of air

sounds.name: Power Up
sounds.desc: A quick rising scale that lands on a held note: you got stronger. Chip is square; off is soft triangle.

pitch.desc: Starting note of the rising scale run

notes.desc: How many notes the run plays, the last one held

gap.desc: Time between notes in the run; smaller is faster

chip.desc: 1 bitcrushed square notes, 0 soft triangles with an octave and vibrato at the end

sounds.name: Punch
sounds.desc: A fist landing with a thump and a smack. Up to three in a flurry, each slightly softer.

pitch.desc: Note of the falling thump; lower is meatier

snap.desc: Brighter smack and louder high slap: 0 a dull thud, 1 a crisp snap

hits.desc: How many punches land in the flurry, each a little softer

gap.desc: Time between punches in a flurry

sounds.name: Shield Up
sounds.desc: An energy field charging up: a humming rise that opens and locks in with a ping. For shields and buffs.

pitch.desc: Starting note of the hum, which climbs an octave; the lock ping follows it

length.desc: How long the shield takes to charge; the lock ping lands near the end

shimmer.desc: Level of the airy shimmer rising with the hum, 0 none

lock.desc: Level of the glassy ping when it locks in, 0 none

sounds.name: Sword Clash
sounds.desc: Steel meeting steel: a hard clang that rings, with an optional scrape. For parries and duels.

pitch.desc: Note of the clang; the second blade rings a third above

ring.desc: How long the steel rings after the clash

scrape.desc: Level and length of the blade-on-blade scrape, 0 none

sounds.name: Sword Swing
sounds.desc: A blade cutting the air: a quick bright swish with a thin edge of steel. Sharper than the generic whoosh.

length.desc: How long the swish takes; attack and tail stretch together

pitch.desc: Shifts the swish bands and the steel ring up or down

edge.desc: Level of the thin steel ring under the swish: 0 pure air

sounds.name: Whoosh
sounds.desc: Air rushing past: a swing, a dash, or a panel sliding across the screen.

length.desc: How long the whoosh lasts; both sweeps stretch with it

pitch.desc: Shifts both sweep bands: low a deep rush, high a thin hiss

q.desc: Narrowness of the sweeps: low a broad rush, high a tighter, whistly band

sounds.name: Chip Click
sounds.desc: A single poker chip clicked down: a crisp clay tick with a short ring and a hint of felt underneath.

pitch.desc: Ring frequency of the clay bands: low duller chip, high crisper and brighter

ring.desc: How long the clay ring lasts after the tick

weight.desc: Felt thump under the click: 0 chip on chip, 1 heavy landing on felt

sounds.name: Chip Stack
sounds.desc: Poker chips stacked one by one: uneven clay clicks climbing a little as the stack grows.

chips.desc: How many chips are stacked, one click each

pace.desc: Average time between chips, with some random unevenness

pitch.desc: Ring frequency of the first chip, later chips climb slightly higher

sounds.name: Chips Push All-In
sounds.desc: A pile of chips pushed forward for an all-in: a swelling rattle of clay clicks that ends in a thud and a few settling chips.

length.desc: Duration of the shove before the heap thuds into the pot

chips.desc: How many clay clicks rattle during the shove

pitch.desc: Center frequency of the clicks and settling chips: low duller, high brighter

slide.desc: Sliding noise under the clicks: 0 nearly silent, 1 loud felt hiss

sounds.name: Card Deal
sounds.desc: One card dealt across the table: a flick off the deck, a soft skim over felt and a quiet landing.

reach.desc: Flight time to the seat: a longer skim and a later landing

tone.desc: Brightness of the flick and skim: 0 dark, 1 bright and airy

land.desc: Weight of the landing: 0 barely touches, 1 firm set-down

sounds.name: Deal a Hand
sounds.desc: A hand dealt round the table, one card per seat, each landing a little differently.

cards.desc: How many cards are dealt, one per seat

gap.desc: Time between one card and the next

spread.desc: How much the landing thump pitch differs by seat: 0 all alike, 1 widest

sounds.name: Dice Roll
sounds.desc: A die thrown and tumbling to rest: bounces that close up and soften, then a last rocking tick.

bounces.desc: How many times the die bounces before rocking to rest

length.desc: Time from the first bounce to the last, gaps shrinking inside it

surface.desc: Table it lands on: 0 dull, short felt to 1 bright, ringing wood

sounds.name: Dice Shake
sounds.desc: Dice shaken in a cup: bursts of hard little clacks at each stroke, swelling and fading.

length.desc: Duration of the whole shake

pitch.desc: Scales the clack, tock and rattle pitch: low chunky, high small and sharp

dice.desc: How many dice: more dice, more clacks per stroke

sounds.name: Card Discard
sounds.desc: A card tossed onto the discard pile: a flick, a short flight and a papery landing on the stack.

toss.desc: Flight before the landing: 0 dropped close, 1 tossed far with a longer whoosh

pile.desc: Cards already on the pile: more adds papery ticks and softens the thump

weight.desc: Heft of the landing thump: 0 light, 1 heavy

sounds.name: Card Draw
sounds.desc: A card drawn off the top of the deck: a rising paper rub that ends in a small snap as it comes free.

reach.desc: Length of the drag before the card comes free

tone.desc: Brightness of the rub and snap: 0 dark, 1 bright

snap.desc: Level of the snap as the card clears the deck: 0 faint, 1 crisp

sounds.name: Fan Out Hand
sounds.desc: A hand of cards fanned open: a quick climbing ratchet of paper ticks over a breath of air.

cards.desc: How many cards tick past as the hand opens

length.desc: Time to fan the whole hand open

bright.desc: Frequency of the ticks and air swell: 0 darker, 1 brighter

sounds.name: Card Flick
sounds.desc: A playing card flicked off the deck, or a short fan of them dealt one after another.

count.desc: How many cards are flicked in a row

gap.desc: Time between successive flicks

bright.desc: Snap brightness: 0 dull, 1 bright, each later card a touch brighter

sounds.name: Card Flip
sounds.desc: A card turned face up: a small scrape, a crisp snap at the turn and a light landing.

speed.desc: Pace of the whole gesture: low slow and drawn out, high quick

snap.desc: Strength of the paper snap at the turn: 0 faint, 1 crisp

tone.desc: Brightness of the scrape and snap: 0 dark, 1 bright

sounds.name: Piece Capture
sounds.desc: One wooden piece knocking another off its square: a sharp clack, then the lost piece skittering away.

pitch.desc: Wood pitch of the clack and of the tocks as the piece skitters away

force.desc: How hard the strike is: louder, brighter clack and a firmer low thump

scatter.desc: How far the taken piece skitters: more tocks, spaced wider apart

sounds.name: Board Piece Move
sounds.desc: A wooden piece slid a little and set down on a board with a hollow, polite tok.

pitch.desc: Wood pitch of the tok, also tinting the drag and click: low big, high small

hollow.desc: Boxiness of the board: 0 dull solid tok, 1 hollow wood-block ring

slide.desc: Drag over the board before set-down, very short values skip the drag sound

sounds.name: Card Place
sounds.desc: A single card set down on the table with a soft pat, felt-dark or wood-bright.

weight.desc: Heft of the pat: 0 light, 1 louder with a deeper thump

drop.desc: Height the card falls from: adds a paper tick and a slightly later landing

sounds.name: Deck Riffle
sounds.desc: A deck riffled together: a quick ripple of paper ticks, never two quite alike.

gap.desc: Time between card ticks: short a fast ripple, long a slower one

pitch.desc: Base frequency of the paper ticks: low dull, high crisp

sounds.name: Overhand Shuffle
sounds.desc: An overhand shuffle: separate short ripples of paper as chunks drop off the deck, then a pat to square it.

chunks.desc: How many chunks are peeled off the deck

pitch.desc: Base frequency of the paper ripples: low dull, high crisp

square.desc: Closing pat that squares the deck: 0 barely there, 1 firm

sounds.name: Card Slide
sounds.desc: A card slid across the felt: a soft breathy glide that falls away from you or rises toward you.

length.desc: Duration of the glide

pitch.desc: Scales the glide and grit frequencies: low dark, high bright

rise.desc: Glide direction: 0 falls away from you, middle flat, 1 rises toward you

grit.desc: Fine gritty grains on top of the glide: 0 smooth, 1 grainy

sounds.name: Turn Timer Tick
sounds.desc: A quiet wooden clock tick-tock for a turn timer, small enough to repeat every second.

pitch.desc: Frequency of the tick, the tock beat sits lower

tone.desc: Character of each beat: 0 soft wooden knock, 1 crisp click

beats.desc: How many beats play, alternating tick and tock

gap.desc: Time between beats

sounds.name: Your Turn
sounds.desc: A gentle two-note mallet cue that says it is your move, with a soft tap of a card underneath.

pitch.desc: Frequency of the first mallet note

interval.desc: How far the second note leaps above the first, default a fifth

bright.desc: Mallet hardness: 0 soft and round, 1 brighter with more overtones

ring.desc: How long the notes ring, the first a little shorter

sounds.name: Arcane Charge
sounds.desc: Energy gathering: a glowing swell climbs in pitch with shimmering overtones and ends in a ready ping.

length.desc: Climb time: how long the swell rises before the ready ping

pitch.desc: Base note: the climb rises to three times it, the ping lands at six times

shimmer.desc: Loudness of the airy high hiss rising with the swell, faint to prominent

space.desc: Room reverb mix, from dry to a lush wash

sounds.name: Curse Hex
sounds.desc: A sinister low toll with a sour interval, a sagging drone and creeping whispers. For debuffs and dark spells.

pitch.desc: Root note: the saw drone sits here, the tolling bells an octave up

dread.desc: Loudness of the sour tritone bell that clashes with the toll

whisper.desc: Loudness of the breathy whisper bursts, faint to upfront

space.desc: Dim room reverb mix, from dry to murky

sounds.name: Enchant
sounds.desc: A harp-like run of plucked notes over a glowing pad, closing on a bell. For enchanting an item.

pitch.desc: First harp note: the run, the glowing pad and the closing bell are tuned from it

notes.desc: How many plucked strings climb the run; more notes reach higher and last longer

speed.desc: Gap between plucks: short for a fast glissando, long for a slow strum

glow.desc: Loudness of the soft pad humming under the harp

space.desc: Room reverb mix, from dry to a lush wash

sounds.name: Fire Spell
sounds.desc: A rushing fireball: a warm thump at the cast, a roar that swells and fades, and crackling embers.

heat.desc: How far the roar's lowpass opens: low a muffled rumble, high a bright blaze

length.desc: How long the roar lasts, with the embers spread across it

crackle.desc: Number of popping embers, from a few to a dense crackle

weight.desc: Loudness of the low thump at ignition

sounds.name: Healing Shimmer
sounds.desc: A warm chord that swells and blooms with a few falling sparkles. For healing, a blessing or a buff.

pitch.desc: Chord root; the falling sparkles are tuned above it

swell.desc: Chord fade-in time: short blooms fast, long swells slowly; sparkles start later too

sparkle.desc: How many sparkles fall, and how loud the airy hiss under them is

space.desc: Warm room reverb mix, from a light touch to a lush wash

sounds.name: Ice Spell
sounds.desc: A crystalline freeze: a glassy ring over a frosty hiss, then icy shards tinkling away downward.

pitch.desc: Glass ring note; the shards start an octave above and fall below it

shards.desc: How many icy shards tinkle down after the ring

frost.desc: Loudness of the frosty high hiss under the glass

space.desc: Bright room reverb mix, from dry to a glittering wash

sounds.name: Lightning Bolt
sounds.desc: A bright crack of electricity that forks into crackling arcs and rolls away as low thunder.

bright.desc: Start pitch of the falling zap in the strike: lower is duller, higher sharper

crackle.desc: How many forked arcs crackle after the strike

rumble.desc: Loudness of the rolling thunder underneath

thunder.desc: How long the thunder rolls on after the strike

space.desc: Small room reverb mix, from dry to roomy

sounds.name: Portal Open
sounds.desc: A swirling gateway tears open: a resonant vortex whirls up, then a deep shimmering chord settles.

size.desc: Build time: how long the vortex whirls before the gateway opens

pitch.desc: Root of the throb, the opening thump and the shimmering chord

swirl.desc: Vortex loudness, plus how fast and hard the throb pulses

space.desc: Big room reverb mix, from dry to cavernous

sounds.name: Potion Bubble
sounds.desc: A bubbling cauldron of glassy bloops with a faint magical glimmer. For potions, brewing and alchemy.

bubbles.desc: How many bloops rise from the cauldron

pitch.desc: Base bloop pitch, each bubble lands randomly around it; glimmers sit far above

span.desc: Time the bubbling spreads over, and the length of the gurgle bed

glimmer.desc: Number and loudness of the faint high magic pings

sounds.name: Magic Sparkle
sounds.desc: A rising twinkle of bright notes over a breath of shimmer, with a little room around it.

notes.desc: How many notes climb the major arpeggio

pitch.desc: First note of the arpeggio; the rest climb from it

gap.desc: Time between notes: short a quick flurry, long a slower twinkle

shimmer.desc: Loudness of the airy high hiss under the notes; none at the bottom

space.desc: Small room reverb mix, from dry to roomy

sounds.name: Spell Cast
sounds.desc: Magic gathered and let go: a quick rising swirl, then a bright bell bloom opening in a soft room.

pitch.desc: Bell bloom note; the swirl rises from an octave below to meet it

gather.desc: Wind-up time of the rising swirl before the bell blooms

bloom.desc: Brightness of the bell: adds upper partials and a sparkle of hiss

space.desc: Soft room reverb mix, from dry to a lush wash

sounds.name: Teleport
sounds.desc: A vanishing rush upward, a beat of silence, then a soft bell where you reappear.

pitch.desc: Start note of the vanishing rush, which shoots up to six times higher

gap.desc: Silence between vanishing and reappearing

reach.desc: Raises the arrival rush and landing bell relative to the departure pitch

space.desc: Room reverb mix, from dry to roomy

sounds.name: Soft Alert Siren
sounds.desc: A gentle two-tone siren that swoops between notes: a warning that gets attention without startling.

pitch.desc: Lower of the two siren notes

cycles.desc: How many up-and-back siren cycles play

interval.desc: Gap between the two siren notes, narrow to wide

rate.desc: Time per swoop: short a hurried alarm, long a slow wail

tone.desc: Lowpass cutoff: low a muffled siren, high a brighter, edgier one

sounds.name: Blaster Bolt
sounds.desc: A heavy plasma shot: a gritty falling snarl with a bright crack on top and a thump underneath.

pitch.desc: Start pitch of the falling snarl and its FM layer

length.desc: Duration of the falling snarl and its FM layer

grit.desc: Saturation on the snarl, from mild to heavily distorted

weight.desc: Loudness of the low thump underneath

sounds.name: Data Stream
sounds.desc: A rapid patter of tiny bitcrushed ticks and chirps, like data pouring through a channel.

ticks.desc: How many ticks pour through, sparse to dense

length.desc: Time the ticks spread over, and the length of the hiss bed

pitch.desc: Center pitch of the ticks

spread.desc: Pitch scatter of the ticks, from one pitch to a wide random spread

grit.desc: Bitcrush depth: low cleaner, high coarser and more lo-fi

sounds.name: Hologram Flicker
sounds.desc: A glassy digital tone that stutters and drops out as a projection flickers, with static in the gaps.

pitch.desc: Base note of the glassy FM tone

flickers.desc: How many bursts the tone stutters into before it settles

glitch.desc: Instability: more bitcrush, wider pitch wander and louder static in the gaps

length.desc: Time the flicker sequence spreads over; the bursts stretch with it

sounds.name: Laser Zap
sounds.desc: A bright falling pew for a laser shot. Fire it once, or in a quick burst of up to four.

pitch.desc: Start pitch of the pew

drop.desc: How far each pew falls: low a short dip, high a deep plunge

shots.desc: How many pews in the burst, each a touch lower than the last

rate.desc: Time between shots in a burst; no effect on a single shot

edge.desc: Square-wave bite: low a smoother sine-like pew, high a buzzier one

sounds.name: Power Down
sounds.desc: A machine spinning down: a falling whine closes under a slowing patter of ticks and ends in a soft clunk.

length.desc: Time the machine takes to wind down before the clunk

pitch.desc: Machine's base pitch, tuning the falling whine and the ticks

ticks.desc: How many ticks slow to a stop under the whine

bright.desc: Starting brightness of the closing lowpass, muted to bright

sounds.name: Power Up
sounds.desc: A machine spinning up: accelerating ticks climb into a rising whine that locks on at full power.

length.desc: Spin-up time before the lock-on chime

pitch.desc: Base pitch: tunes the climbing whine, the ticks and the lock-on chime

ticks.desc: How many accelerating ticks play during the spin-up

bright.desc: How far the lowpass opens by the end: duller to brighter whine

sounds.name: Robot Chirp
sounds.desc: A quick burst of FM chirps that swoop up and down like a small, expressive droid.

pitch.desc: Base voice pitch; chirps wander within about an octave of it

chirps.desc: How many chirps the droid says

mood.desc: Chance each chirp swoops up: low glum and falling, high perky and rising

speed.desc: Average chirp length: short a quick chatter, long slower syllables

sounds.name: Scanner Sweep
sounds.desc: A narrow beam sweeping up and back with a wobble, ending on a two-blip confirm.

pitch.desc: Bottom of the sweep; the beam climbs two octaves and the blips sit above

sweeps.desc: Number of beam passes, alternating up and back, before the confirm blips

length.desc: Duration of each sweep

wobble.desc: Depth of the fast tremolo on the beam, steady to warbling

sounds.name: Shield Hum
sounds.desc: A throbbing energy hum that swells in as a shield powers up, then settles into a slow pulse.

pitch.desc: Base pitch of the hum; a square sits an octave under, a thin whine high above

pulse.desc: How fast the hum throbs, slow pulse to rapid flutter

bright.desc: How far the resonant lowpass opens, and the level of the thin top whine

length.desc: How long the shield hums before fading

sounds.name: Terminal Blip
sounds.desc: A quick run of bitcrushed computer beeps, like a console printing a readout or acknowledging a command.

pitch.desc: First beep's pitch; later beeps pick scale notes up to an octave above

count.desc: How many beeps in the run

grit.desc: Bitcrush depth: low cleaner beeps, high crunchier with choppier tails

sounds.name: Warp Jump
sounds.desc: An engine whine winds up, then the ship leaps: a stretched streak and a deep thump as it vanishes.

charge.desc: Wind-up time of the engine before the jump

pitch.desc: Engine base pitch, tuning the rising whine and the zip at the jump

boom.desc: Loudness of the deep thump as the ship vanishes

tail.desc: Length of the falling noise streak after the jump

sounds.name: Cave Drips
sounds.desc: Slow drips falling in a damp stone chamber, each one ringing in the echo, over a low draft of air.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

drips.desc: How many drips fall during the bed

pitch.desc: Scales drip pitch: low heavy drops, high small bright ones

cave.desc: Chamber echo: 0 shorter and drier, 1 longer and wetter

sounds.name: Distant Thunder
sounds.desc: A storm miles away: a muffled crack and a long low rumble that rolls and fades out.

length.desc: Total duration of the rumble and its rolls

distance.desc: How far the storm is: 0 near with a loud crack, 1 far, darker, no crack

rolls.desc: How many later rolls re-light the rumble after the first

sounds.name: Fire Crackle
sounds.desc: A hearth or campfire: a soft roar of flame with random snaps, pops and the odd log settling.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

crackle.desc: Density of snaps and pops, and how often a log settles

roar.desc: Level of the flame roar and its flicker swells: 0 nearly silent, 1 full

tone.desc: Crackle brightness: 0 dull and woody, 1 bright and sharp

sounds.name: Forest Birds
sounds.desc: Morning birdsong in the trees: tweets, trills and whistles from near and far over a faint breeze.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

activity.desc: How many bird phrases sing: 0 sparse, 1 busy

pitch.desc: Scales all the birdsong pitch: low deeper, high shriller

trill.desc: Share of phrases that are fast warbling trills rather than tweets or whistles

sounds.name: Ocean Surf
sounds.desc: Waves building and breaking on a beach, each with a hiss of foam, over a low swell. Fades in and out.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

period.desc: Time between waves, longer also makes each wave build slower

foam.desc: Level of the foam hiss after each crest: 0 none, 1 full

depth.desc: Low sea swell under the waves: 0 nearly gone, 1 heavy

sounds.name: Rain
sounds.desc: Rain on leaves and puddles, from a drizzle to a steady downpour. Fades in and out.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

rate.desc: Rain intensity: 0 light drizzle to 1 steady downpour, more drops and plinks

tone.desc: Brightness of the hiss, drops and plinks: 0 dull, 1 bright

sounds.name: Room Tone Hum
sounds.desc: A quiet indoor bed: electrical hum with its buzzing harmonics over a breath of ventilation hiss.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

pitch.desc: Mains hum frequency, with a soft sine an octave above it

buzz.desc: Brightness of the sawtooth buzz: 0 dull hum, 1 bright buzzy harmonics

sounds.name: Space Drone
sounds.desc: A slow, deep drone for a ship or a void: a dark pad that opens up, with a faint shimmer far above.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

pitch.desc: Root frequency of the drone, harmonics and shimmer follow it

tone.desc: How far the slowly opening filter reaches: 0 dark, 1 brighter

shimmer.desc: Level of the high trembling shimmer: 0 none, 1 full

sounds.name: Wind Gusts
sounds.desc: An open-air wind bed: steady air with slow gusts rolling through and a faint whistle. Fades in and out.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

gust.desc: Strength of the slow passing gusts: 0 steady air only, 1 strong gusts

pitch.desc: Scales air, gust and whistle pitch at even level: low deep, high thin

whistle.desc: Thin whistle through a gap: 0 none, 1 clearly audible

sounds.name: Alert Sting
sounds.desc: Short minor stabs and a long tense chord with a sub thump, for danger, a boss entrance or a hard warning.

tempo.desc: Higher plays the stabs and the chord faster and shorter

stabs.desc: Number of short minor stabs before the long chord

edge.desc: Bit-crush amount: 0 light 8-bit grit, 1 coarser and harsher

sounds.name: Defeat Jingle
sounds.desc: A falling four-note sad-brass wah for a lost round: three short steps down and one long sagging note.

tempo.desc: Higher plays the four notes faster and shorter, lower drags them out

droop.desc: Sag and wobble on the last note: 0 steady, 1 a deep wobbling slide down

tone.desc: Brightness of the wah filter: 0 dark and muffled, 1 brassier

sounds.name: Short Fanfare
sounds.desc: Three stabs and a long chord on synth brass: an announcement or a proud arrival in two seconds.

tempo.desc: Higher plays the stabs and the final chord faster and shorter

brass.desc: How far each note's filter opens: 0 a mellow horn, 1 a bright brassy blat

weight.desc: Level of the low octave root and the cymbal wash on the final chord

sounds.name: Intro Logo Sting
sounds.desc: A rising sweep that opens into a warm, ringing major-seventh chord with a glint on top. A calm logo reveal.

tempo.desc: Higher shortens the rising sweep so the chord lands sooner

shine.desc: Level of the high bell glint over the chord

space.desc: Reverb mix: low keeps the chord close, high a long washy room

sounds.name: Level Complete
sounds.desc: A warm plucked arpeggio climbing into a ringing bell chord. For finishing a stage, not a whole game.

tempo.desc: Higher climbs the arpeggio faster and lands the chord sooner

sparkle.desc: Lifts the top bell and the airy high shimmer at the landing

space.desc: Reverb mix over everything, from dry to roomy

sounds.name: Menu Confirm Melody
sounds.desc: Two to four quick rising notes with an echo, for pressing Start or confirming a menu choice.

notes.desc: How many rising notes play, always ending on the high tonic

speed.desc: Higher plays the run faster; the final held note keeps its length

echo.desc: Level and feedback of the trailing echo: 0 dry, 1 a longer trail

sounds.name: Mystery Sting
sounds.desc: Two hanging bell tones a tritone apart over a dark swell. For a clue, a twist or a door that should not open.

tempo.desc: Higher brings the second bell in sooner and swells the pad quicker

eerie.desc: Opens the bells' FM clang, wobbles the pad and adds a high hiss

space.desc: Reverb mix of the big dark room, from close to cavernous

sounds.name: Ta-da
sounds.desc: A cheerful two-chord reveal: a quick staccato hit and a bright held chord with a sparkle on top.

tempo.desc: Higher brings the held chord in sooner and quickens the glissando

sparkle.desc: Level of the rising glissando and the high bell on top

weight.desc: Level of the low bass note under the held chord

sounds.name: Victory Jingle
sounds.desc: A chiptune win: a quick rising arpeggio into a held major chord. Bright, short and proud.

tempo.desc: Higher plays the arpeggio faster and shortens the held chord

crunch.desc: Bit-crush amount: 0 light 8-bit grit, 1 grittier and harsher

bass.desc: Level of the low triangle bass under the held chord

themes.name: Soft UI
themes.desc: Quiet, rounded feedback for productivity apps: soft ticks, a gentle chime, a low buzz.

themes.name: 8-bit
themes.desc: Chiptune: square and triangle beeps, bitcrushed blips and arpeggio jingles in C major.

themes.name: Arcade
themes.desc: Punchy, bright game feedback and big wins: sharp clicks, ringing pings, brass fanfares, a real boom.

themes.name: Fantasy
themes.desc: Spells, chimes and parchment for game menus and role-playing games: harps, bells, a quill and a fireball.

themes.name: Glass
themes.desc: Bright, bell-like and airy: struck-glass ticks, high chimes and sparkle. Clean and a little cold.
